plan.title: Scholarship Scheme Progress by District
plan.subtitle: Overview of application status and pending cases across Gaya, Muzaffarpur, and Pune

panels.title: Total Applicants
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants

panels.title: Pending Cases
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE Status = 'Pending'

panels.title: Disbursed Count
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE Status = 'Disbursed'

panels.title: Approval Rate
panels.sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN Status IN ('Approved', 'Disbursed') THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants

panels.title: Applications by District
panels.sql: SELECT District, COUNT(*) AS app_count FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Status Distribution by District
panels.sql: SELECT District, Status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC

panels.title: Pending Cases Detail
panels.sql: SELECT "Naam", "Pita ka naam", "District", "Name of scheme", "Marks %" FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE Status = 'Pending' ORDER BY "Marks %" DESC LIMIT 10
